violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING PREPARATION. CONSIDER HAVING ANOTHER EMPLOYEE OBTAIN CERTIFICATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: IN HOUSE GRILLED CHILE SAUCE AT 52F, IN HOUSE ROASTED GARLIC SAUCE AT 51F AND CHILE DE ARBOL SAUCE AT 52F IN ICE BATH AT SIDE SERVICE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TPHC PROCEDURES FOR IN-HOUSE SAUCES AND PLACED LABELS FOR DISCARD UNUSED PORTIONS AT 4:00 PM. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PURCHASED PROBE THERMOMETER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS/BOTTLES OF OILS, SPICES AND SAUCES NEAR GRILL LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.
